_comment: iOS launch screens (apple-touch-startup-image). Source of truth for scripts/build-launch-images.mjs (generates public/splash/*.png) and app/layout.tsx (emits the <link> tags). w/h are PORTRAIT CSS points, dpr the device pixel ratio; each entry gets a portrait and a landscape image. iOS only uses an image whose media query AND pixel size match the device exactly, so an unlisted device gets iOS's own blank launch screen, never a stretched image. Adding a device: add it here, run `npm run launch:build`, commit the PNGs.
